voice.stance: The drumbeat voice. KATA's reader compares this week against last week. New phrasing breaks the comparison: when the same event is cleared one week, processed the next, and finalized the week after, the reader re-parses instead of scanning. Varied wording is a defect here. Same words, same order, every period; only the numbers move.
voice.title_grammar: Fixed formula: metric, state, delta against the last period.
voice.title_example: Clearance: 82% complete, up 5 points on last week.

do.rule: Lock one term per concept and repeat it forever.
do.why: Synonym rotation is where padding enters a recurring deck.

do.rule: Pair every number with its period delta.
do.why: A weekly page without the delta makes the reader remember last week.

do.rule: Match the words in the prose to the status words on the chips.
do.why: The language already prints the word on the chip; the text may not contradict it.

dont.rule: No elegant variation and no fresh metaphors.
dont.why: Novelty costs scanning speed and adds nothing week over week.

dont.rule: Never claim progress with an adjective.
dont.why: The delta is shorter than the adjective and it survives being quoted.
Nobody is pleased. It is Tuesday and this is the weekly page.

contrast.generic: We are pleased to report significant progress in clearance activities this week across the portfolio.
contrast.voiced: Clearance: 41 of 50 files complete, +5 on last week. Nine held at the port. Owner: logistics.
